method: Whole traverse.c/h reads with pinned Git blob verification.
findings: Root stat/lstat failure logs error but still returns zero-initialized traversal buffer; root processing later rejects unsupported mode. No typed per-root failure result here.
Traversal marks unreadable/skipped/cyclic branches not fully traversed, preventing those branches from being emitted as fully traversed duplicate-directory candidates.
Directory task returns TRUE even after fts_open/children failures as scheduler task-processed signal. This return is not evidence of complete traversal.
fts_children NULL early exits in directory task bypass fts_close; empty-directory helper also returns early without close. Runtime resource leak not reproduced.
Explicit zero-sized files are classified as empty-file lint before permissions/other checks when enabled; default minsize1 therefore does not mean they are compared as ordinary exact duplicates.
Symlink following resolves target relative to link directory, while non-follow mode can compare stored link target strings. Link target and regular-file groups separated by reviewed ranking.
Entry admission snapshots metadata and optionally reads xattr hash. No fresh file identity/content validation in this traversal module after collection.

FTS_DEFAULT shares admission branch with regular files; direct roots separately reject unsupported modes. Special descendant behavior depends on FTS/platform metadata and downstream size filters, not tested.
limits: Static traversal review only; physical permissions, symlink races and FTS behavior not executed.
No rrrah edits/tests; native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
